question: Which sulphur containing preservative is used to increase the shelf life of meat products such as fresh sausages and burgers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sodium metabisulphite**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sodium metabisulphite** is commonly used as a preservative in meat products such as fresh sausages and burgers.
 
• It helps to increase the shelf life of these products by preventing microbial growth and oxidation.
 
• Sodium metabisulphite is effective in maintaining the color and flavor of meat products, ensuring they remain appealing to consumers for a longer period.
 
• It is important to use this preservative within the recommended limits to avoid any adverse health effects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sodium metabisulphite is also used in other food products, such as dried fruits and vegetables, to preserve their quality.
 
• It is a white crystalline powder with a pungent odor and is soluble in water.
 
• In addition to its use as a preservative, sodium metabisulphite is employed in various industrial applications, including water treatment and chemical manufacturing.
 
• Consumers should be aware that some individuals may have sensitivities or allergies to sulfites, and it is important to check food labels for the presence of sodium metabisulphite.
